admission.justification: The pane presents model choices separately from feature replies so a model stays startable under its defaults when the host does not answer its options lookup.

applicability: A new dashboard role Start from available model inventory with pending or nonfresh selected-model options.
conditions: The selected pair remains in the current or matching saved inventory.
The Start payload retains the selection and omits explicit feature values until the pair has a fresh feature answer.
exclusions: An exact saved Retry retains its earlier values. Existing selection and receipt eligibility checks still apply.

evidence: Mounted unavailable-options and effort provenance tests and the W5 pinned route outage. CUR-F01 guide-to-source comparison and current mounted tests.

statement: Model and receipt metadata remain usable with unavailable options, and a new Start can omit explicit feature values.
